reason: The plants need shelter before laboratory power is shed, so placing the charged heat store in the growing nook seems like a useful first step.
expectation: I expect the warm tank to provide stored heat inside the nook, though it may need the plants placed there separately.

alternatives.reason: The battery should provide reserve power, but the introduction suggests preparing the plants and core first.
Moving the lettuce into the nook also seems useful; I chose to put its heat source there first.

effect: The heat store created a buffered growing nook, so I can now move the plants into it.
reaction: That fits my expectation, though I am curious how the nook will protect both beds.
reason: The lettuce needs shelter before the station switches to reserve power, so I will place it in the buffered nook.
expectation: I expect the lettuce trough to be sheltered in the nook; the potato trough will likely need a separate action.

alternatives.reason: The potatoes need shelter too; I chose the lettuce first without a clear reason to prioritize either.

effect: The lettuce is sheltered with its roots wet and warmed by the heat store, so the potato trough is the remaining visible plant to move.
reaction: It is satisfying that the earlier heat store is already helping the lettuce.
reason: The potatoes also need shelter before the station switches to reserve power.
expectation: I expect the potato trough to be sheltered inside the warmed nook as well.

alternatives.reason: The service trench may need attention, but I want to shelter both plants first.

effect: Both plant troughs are now sheltered, with the potato cover and support still in place. I can turn to the remaining preparations for reserve power.
reaction: It is reassuring that the deeper trough fits without disturbing the leaves or tuber cover.
reason: The service trench is the remaining preparation before selecting reserve power. The compatibility hint suggests the tool can adjust it, though its purpose is not yet clear.
expectation: I expect to access or modify something in the insulated trench, possibly to help prepare a backup connection, but I am unsure.

alternatives.reason: The battery can select reserve power, but the introduction says to prepare the core's backup connection first.

effect: The service tool drained the insulated water line; its pump and thaw checks remain on essential power, with the inlet closed until the pipe is ready. The core’s backup connection has not yet been explained.
reaction: I was surprised the trench action drained the water line, though the result clarifies how it is left for the reserve period.
reason: Selecting the charged battery is the only available combination and should put the station on its planned reserve.
expectation: I expect the station to switch to reserve power; I am unsure how the frozen core’s backup connection will be handled.

effect: The station is on reserve power, the fuel plant has shut down, and the laboratory circuit remains on for the cold case’s changeover. The result does not explain a separate backup connection for the core.
reaction: I am relieved the essential loads have power, but confused that the message says the garden can move into the nook now when both troughs are already sheltered.

mostWorthwhile.text: Sheltering the lettuce was satisfying because the heat store placed earlier was already keeping its roots warm, connecting the preparations to a concrete result.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs separately felt somewhat repetitive, although the potato result usefully explained how its cover and support fit.

surprise.text: The service tool drained the water line; I had expected a possible backup connection rather than that preparation.

arbitrary.text: The service tool and insulated trench were compatible, but their purpose was unclear until the line was drained. The final message about moving the garden also seemed out of sequence with the actions already taken.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the frozen core’s backup connection is handled, since the chapter ends with its changeover still unexplained.
